items.title: Examiner Allowance Rates Under Director Squires
items.summary: Examiner allowance rate data through January 2026 shows no Squires bump. The rate sits near 75%, well below the 2022-2023 peak above 82%. Continue reading this post on Patently-O.

items.title: Rise of AI Patents and their Corresponding Eligibility Rejections
items.summary: AI applications draw §101 rejections at 42% against 7% for everything else, while §103 rates are identical. The 2019 guidance effect has eroded. Continue reading this post on Patently-O.

items.title: Rise of OpenAI in the Patent System
